claims.text: The review's challenge table holds five questions: API calling the SMS provider (ADR 0002), email service down a day (ADR 0027 retry, ADR 0024 conditions), one shop's sale day (risk, ADR 0016 cap, backend developer), push not built (dependency, product owner), customer dropping email (no, ADR 0027).
ADR 0002 split Notifications into its own service so every service notifies customers the same way and a slow or failing mail server does not take resources of the process taking orders.
ADR 0027 lists 'the API, or each service, calls the provider directly' as a rejected option because it goes against ADR 0002.

Per the review's retry section (design under ADR 0027): each channel retries for 24 hours (assumed), gaps growing up to a ceiling; after 24 hours the row becomes failed and is shown to the operations team to resend by hand when the provider is back.
claims.source_hint: docs/design/notification-design-review.md @ stage-4 lines 64-69; docs/adr/0027-*.md @ stage-4 lines 40-42

claims.text: ADR 0027 review conditions include: 24 hours of retry is not enough for one outage of the email service.
The review answers repeated email outages by pointing to ADR 0024's review conditions.

ADR 0024 (which chose Service A) review conditions: delivery rate below the level assumed in email-service-evaluation.md, price above the assumed TCO, A no longer accepting email over SMTP; none names an outage. SMTP is the standard protocol for handing an email to a mail server.
claims.source_hint: docs/adr/0024-dich-vu-gui-email-ben-ngoai.md @ stage-4 lines 58-63; RFC 5321 section 1 (purpose of SMTP)

claims.text: Each waiting message is a row with next_attempt_at; senders take due rows by that time, not by shop, so one shop's busy day slows other shops' emails, against driver 3; next step: a cap per shop for each round of taking rows, as in ADR 0016; owner: backend developer.
At stage-4 ADR 0027 is not built: Notifications still sends only email, as at stage-3.

Push needs a phone build of the app (ADR 0017), which does not exist; push waits for it, email and SMS do not wait for a phone build; owner: product owner. SMS still needs its provider chosen in its own ADR.
claims.source_hint: docs/design/notification-design-review.md @ stage-4 lines 100, 105-106, 115; docs/adr/0027-*.md @ stage-4 lines 56-58

claims.text: ADR 0017 keeps one Flutter code base; stage-4 adds no android/ or ios/ folder; Android and iOS are built from the same code when a shop needs an installed app.
claims.source_hint: docs/adr/0017-giu-mot-ma-flutter-cho-moi-nen-tang.md @ stage-4 'Các phương án' first option and 'Quyết định'

claims.text: A customer cannot choose SMS only without email: email is the channel of record, a sensitivity point of ADR 0027.
claims.source_hint: docs/design/notification-design-review.md @ stage-4 line 116; docs/adr/0027-*.md @ stage-4 lines 66-68

claims.text: The review's drivers are ranked: 1 no lost order email, 2 email within minutes, 3 one shop's busy day does not slow other shops' emails, 4 a paid SMS is not sent twice.
A push service and an SMS provider are each to be chosen in their own ADR, the way ADR 0024 chose the email service; ADR 0027 chooses no provider.
claims.source_hint: docs/adr/0027-*.md @ stage-4 lines 57-58; docs/design/notification-design-review.md @ stage-4 lines 105-106

claims.text: SMS is at most once under ADR 0027: the row is marked before calling the provider; when it is unclear whether it was sent, it is not resent; every order message also goes by email.
ADR 0002 context: the payment gateway was to be called from another service (ADR 0003), which must also notify customers; the chosen option has Notifications receive messages via RabbitMQ.
Answer a challenge from the recorded ADR or review condition while its facts hold; record a risk with a next step from an existing decision rather than designing a new mechanism in the session.

Recording a risk fits a lower-ranked driver (3) with an owner and next step; a risk against the first-ranked driver (no lost order email) would weigh far more heavily, a strong reason to question accepting the design as written.

open_questions: ADR 0024's review conditions do not name an outage; the review row sends repeated outages there anyway. The lesson states this plainly instead of inferring which condition an outage meets.
